script_text: Stop forcing your steady heart to stay still, Taurus — this week, Venus, your ruling planet and Earth element, is about to shake foundations. Early this week, Venus squares Saturn in your seventh house, amplifying trust issues in love while Mercury enters your fifth house, sparking creative flare-ups. Monday and Tuesday are your hardest days, because that tense square won't let love feel safe. Midweek, the Moon turns direct in your second house, trine Venus, bringing emotional clarity. Late week, Jupiter in your tenth house sextile Mars expands career and money luck, urging bold moves. Thursday through Sunday, romance may feel fragile, but professional luck rises. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth house, igniting passion. Sunday is your worst day, facing Mercury opposition Pluto. Weekly advice: pause before sharing your heart or wallet. Follow for daily updates.
